# AI-edited group-photo environment transfer

[← Back to external website archive](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Two AI-edited outputs transfer a group and lettering from the left panel of a public-source reference composite into the environment shown on its right. These are edited demonstrations, not authentic event photographs. The reference composite is one file with two input views and is not counted as a model output. No identities are inferred from faces. Original provenance metadata is retained. Its generic gpt-image claim does not independently establish the 2.6 family or variant, and its signatures have not been authenticated. The source reports xhigh quality, high complexity and first-returned outputs. Those settings and the model identity were not independently reproduced. The original request is public at the linked section; this record supplies only an independent short description and does not reproduce the full prompt. Source timing, cost and quality rankings are not adopted as verified benchmarks.
